zen.text: Nissa Revane is an elf of Zendikar whose people say she will save the elves, but only those who prove their worth, and in the Eldrazi war, Gideon sees elementals of tree and stone marching through Sea Gate and knows Nissa has returned, bringing Zendikar with her, and she joins him and Kiora in the lighthouse as Jori En warns that Ulamog is coming.

When Jace pitches a hedron trap, Nissa objects to trapping the titan, but she works with him anyway, finding the tilted hedron that keeps the ring from lighting, and the titan is pulled into the glowing prison.

The victory does not last: Nissa heaves the last hedron into place, but when she calls on Ashaya the circle breaks, Ulamog is freed, and Ob Nixilis calls up Kozilek and cuts her off from Zendikar and its leylines.

Chandra finds Nissa hanging in midair with Gideon and Jace, and the four defeat the demon together; when Jace suggests leaving Zendikar to its fate, Nissa refuses and the four swear to keep watch, and nissa then shares her mind with Jace and the two plan to drain the titans' energy into Zendikar's leylines so the world can devour them, and before leaving with the Gatewatch she plants four seeds at the glyph and promises Zendikar's soul she will see it again.

roe.text: Nissa Revane first meets the Eldrazi as the brood attacks the Tajuru meeting and kills Sutina, and Sorin Markov arrives in time to save her from it.
She meets Sorin and the vampire Anowon, who is freed when the brood are killed, and Sorin recruits her to guide him toward Akoum.

Along the journey Nissa wins over the Moon Kraken Brinelin by telling him of Sutina's death, is taken prisoner by nulls and rescued by her companions, and pushes Sorin until he admits he is a vampire and the cause of the vanishings.
At the Eye of Ugin, Nissa shatters the main hedron and dissolves the binding enchantment, releasing the Eldrazi titans, and Sorin, who meant to keep them sealed, abandons the plane and Nissa.

cns.text: Nissa wakes pinned beneath a fallen tree after the Eldrazi swarm and Ulamog's return devastate her Joraga tribe, too drained to planeswalk.
A human man pulls her free, and in a tent Hamadi tells her the Joraga are no more, then tells her how the Eldrazi destroyed his own people, leaving Nissa overcome with guilt.
She joins Hamadi's party on a climb through gravity fields of floating boulders, and when a Pathrazer spawn of Ulamog attacks, she pours all her power into earth elementals that crush it.
Afterward Hamadi tells her that Zendikar has chosen her and that the name he gave her, Shaya, means Worldwaker.

ori.text: Nissa Revane's origin begins at home, where she wakes screaming from a vision of a black knot choking a stream of living light and overhears Numa tell her mother he must send them away because of her visions, and she slips away so the horror will find only her, and a shimmering stream wraps around her and connects her with Zendikar's soul; with Mazik, who followed her, she realizes Zendikar is in pain and wants her help.

On the road she summons a huge land elemental against vampires, calms the Roil by humming her mother's animist song, and follows an elemental to the ring of hedrons, where Mazik falls ill and she goes on alone.

At the dark knot, madness shows her the monster inside and her spark ignites, hurling her to Lorwyn, where she joins a blight hunt, turns her blade on the elf Galed for killing boggarts, and escapes as the Great Aurora of Shadowmoor arrives.

Back on Zendikar, Nissa names the elemental Ashaya, the Awoken World, and takes four seeds from a vampire sent by Anowon, then understands that Zendikar did not choose her but that she is one with it, and charges into the forest bonded to the land.

bfz.text: Nissa and Ashaya kill an Eldrazi at a thicket, but then a terrible pain strikes as Nissa's connection to Zendikar is torn away and Ashaya collapses and shatters, and nissa wakes in silence, stumbles toward the Eldrazi at Sea Gate, and is saved by Gideon, who leads the survivors to an encampment, where she reaches out and finds Zendikar empty; she leaves in the night.
After freeing trapped goblins, she realizes Zendikar's soul may have retreated to Khalni Heart and planeswalks to Bala Ged, which she finds entirely consumed by white corruption.

There she finds the wilted Khalni Heart imprisoned in a ring of hedrons, and when a demon traps her she pours her essence into the Heart, the soul returns to the land and Ashaya rises as her friend, ready to join Gideon's army at Sea Gate.

At Sea Gate, Nissa raises hedrons around Ulamog while Gideon wrestles him and Jace triggers the network, but Ob Nixilis summons Kozilek and captures and tortures Gideon, Jace and Nissa until Chandra frees them.

ogw.text: Freed by Chandra from Ob Nixilis's cave, Nissa swears with Gideon, Jace and Chandra to stand together, forming the Gatewatch.

Jace and Nissa then devise a plan to destroy the titans for good, in which Jace discovers the leyline pattern needed to anchor Ulamog and Kozilek and Nissa traces it on her world, while Gideon lures the titans into the ambush.
Kiora betrays the group, but Jace deflects her attack, and Chandra, linked with Nissa, channels her fire through the leylines and incinerates Ulamog and Kozilek.
Jace and Gideon leave Zendikar to gather intelligence, while Nissa stays as its guardian and plants the seeds of Bala Ged's native plants.

kld.text: On Kaladesh, Nissa travels with Chandra and angrily confronts Liliana for leaving without telling the others, while Mrs. Pashiri brings Chandra and Nissa to Yahenni's party.
Yahenni explains that aetherborn are the city's own natural beings, and Nissa senses that this world is structured and cyclical; she helps remove an enforcer so they can have Yahenni's information.

Nissa tells the sharp-tongued Chandra that Ulamog destroyed her people's home of Bala Ged, and when Baral traps them and Chandra nearly self-implodes, Nissa talks her down and guides her to put out the fire.
Nissa comforts Yahenni with land energy, calling them her friend, and tells Chandra she wants to be her friend too, before the Gatewatch gathers to confront Tezzeret.

akh.text: The Gatewatch lands in an Amonkhet sandstorm, where Nissa senses that the plane's life magic is dominated by death and later that the world suffers an ancient curse inverting life and death, and she rescues Gideon from the undead, and after a jackal-headed figure saves the group they find a barrier-shielded city on a river and Nissa helps Jace open a hole in the Hekma to enter.
In an old alley, Nissa reads carved glyphs of eight gods and concludes that Bolas corrupted Amonkhet rather than creating it, then confides in Chandra that she is learning what friendship means.

Caught in Kefnet's Trial of Knowledge, Nissa finds a gap in the trap, sees a vision of a dark snake's shadow swearing to drain every world, and rewrites Kefnet's corrupted leylines so he no longer wants to destroy her, resolving to stop being a pawn.

When the Gatewatch quarrel and Liliana's demon bloodspell sets the Hours in motion, they attack Bolas with everything they have, but he strangles Nissa with necrotic tendrils, corrupts the leylines she controls, and Gideon's interruption lets her flee the plane.

znr.text: Nissa joins Nahiri on the pillar when Nahiri says she may have a way to heal Zendikar, and the two climb the Skyclave, with Nissa saving her from a collapsing stair with a vine.

Inside, Nahiri takes the key and reveals she seeks the last lithoform core, and when she uses the key to stop the Roil, the fern elemental that guided them withers and dies; Nissa demands the key, the two fight, and Nissa leaves, vowing to protect her home with or without the Gatewatch.
She later destroys the focal point with the elementals and feels betrayed when Jace sides partly with Nahiri, and she and Ashaya merge in full power and cut them off at the city gates.
When Jace tries to take control of her mind, Nissa snaps the link, Ashaya pins him and the Core is tossed to her, and she merges her magic with it, flattening the Singing City and healing Zendikar.

one.text: Nissa Revane arrives on New Phyrexia but a trap shunts her away at once, and she later turns up fighting a Phyrexian construct beside the Wanderer when Lukka finds her.
In the Hunter Maze, Lukka and Nissa attack Vorinclex and Glissa, and Nissa wounds Vorinclex, but Lukka is compleated and joins Glissa, so Nissa flees with the Wanderer's help.
Nissa is soon captured and compleated, and she arrives with Elesh Norn to thwart the strike team at the Seedcore, accelerating Realmbreaker's growth as the invasion begins.
Karn and Melira help to restore Nissa's body and spark, but her spark fades in the Great Desparkening.

mat.text: In the aftermath, Nissa digs a grave in Zhalfir, wondering whether she lost her spark, and feels cut off from a plane that will not answer her.
Chandra helps her melt and bury her Phyrexian carapace, but when Chandra says she will leave to find Ajani, Nissa asks what kind of love Chandra has for her and, hurt by the answer, tells her to go.

A lightning-veined beast bursts from a rift, and Nissa, without magic or leylines, is thrown by it until Teferi and Karn restrain it, and then Chandra returns to help, and trapped in a pit, Nissa confronts Chandra about her broken promise and Chandra says she still wants to know her, so Nissa calls to Zhalfir in a chorus and the plane forgives her.
Nissa channels Zhalfir's power into Chandra to turn the storm elemental into steam and rain, and after they kiss, the two step through the portal hand in hand, hoping to find Zendikar.

j25.text: Nissa, with or without her spark, remains an explorer.
